name: dry-eyes
description: Finds SEMANTIC duplicate code across a whole repository for Claude Code — the same business rule, calculation, or UI/UX pattern implemented independently more than once, often with different behavior each time. Not a copy-paste/token clone detector: profiles the repo, picks cheap deterministic duplication signals, clusters candidates, verifies each cluster skeptically, then compares every variant's actual behavior against the others. Install, then use /dry-eyes init and /dry-eyes scan.
